checkpoint: Wild battles on Route 6 until the lead is Lv31: at Lv29 with Dig, console B's lead (m73) lost to Lt. Surge's Raichu, which it outspeeds at Lv31. The grass nearest the city is Route 6's south patch (13..16, 30..33); Picnicker Isabelle (13, 32) faces west over (10..12, 32), on the way north from the city, so the walk goes along Jeff's row 33 (he is beaten) to the wall (7, 33), up to row 31 and east along it onto the patch's west edge, (13, 31), above Isabelle, out of her line. Back to the nurse the same way. All that is skipped when the lead, read in the Center, is Lv31 already. Then the tree, the gym, whose trainers stand where the map has them, beaten, and whose beams stay off (FLAG_FOUND_BOTH_VERMILION_GYM_SWITCHES): up column 5 to below Lt. Surge, and saved there.
